entities.summary: Ilse Junkermann is a German bishop and was from 2009 to 2019 German bishop of the Evangelical Church in Central Germany, a member church of the Evangelical Church in Germany. She was the first woman to become Landesbischof there. She is a pacifist. Ilse Junkermann was a theologians & scholars from Dörzbach (b. 1957-05-31, Dörzbach). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
